item.title: Senate votes to require candidates to raise at least half their money within Georgia
item.description: Republicans in the Georgia Senate passed a bill Friday that bans candidates from raising more than half of their campaign money from outside of the state, a limitation that Democrats said inhibits their fundraising in nationalized elections.

item.title: Senators vote to expand Georgia’s ‘stand your ground’ laws
item.description: The Georgia Senate approved a bill Friday that broadens “stand your ground” self-defense protections, a proposal that critics said would help protect defendants such as those who murdered Ahmaud Arbery.

item.title: Valwood students explore Spanish language and culture in Sevilla
item.description: Eight Valwood Upper School students recently participated in the Spain Mini Study Abroad program with Centro MundoLengua, an immersive experience designed to strengthen language skills and connect classroom learning to real-life Spanish culture.

item.title: Lowndes County Fire Rescue encourages residents to check home safety as Daylight Saving Time begins
item.description: Lowndes County Fire Rescue reminds residents that Daylight Saving Time begins this Sunday, which is also a good time to check smoke alarms and other home safety needs.
